goal: Advance the coherent-transition layer from SYNCHRONY_OBSERVED to THRESHOLD_ESTABLISHED only when all recursive-continuity predicates are evidenced.
originating_session_goal: Activate the layer when built, coordinate work without external tasks, and preserve the session state durably.
machine_observable_release_condition: All seven threshold predicates are true in the derived state, the non-manufacture rule is satisfied, and every evidence reference resolves to a committed file.
next_executable_action: Run scripts/derive_coherent_transition_threshold.py --apply after each relevant heartbeat, orchestration, or repository-task state change, then run scripts/check_coherent_transition_threshold_activation.py.
collision_boundaries: No session or issue may manually set THRESHOLD_ESTABLISHED.
No activation authority is inferred from file presence or ordinary validator success.
No external task or external-session owner is permitted.
